question: And how is it solved?
answer: Organizations can manage these forces by utilizing management accounting practices, which provide intelligence on customers and competitors. This enables informed decision-making regarding the competitive environment to mitigate detrimental effects and enhance organizational performance and competitive advantage.

sources.quote: In particular, we maintain that through providing information which enhances an organisation’s understanding of their competitive forces, and which informs decision making in respect to the man­ agement of such forces, management accounting practices will positively moderate the association between the intensity of competitive forces with organisational per­ formance and competitive advantage.

The effect of Porter’s competitive forces on competitive advantage and… 307 research, in particular the emerging line of research on the strategic role of manage­ ment accounting practices, by informing practitioners of the appropriate management accounting practices to deploy in different circumstances in order to enhance the effects of the intensity of competitive forces.

In particular, through providing organisations with intelligence on their customers (Liu & Atuahene-Gima, 2018) and competitors (Kohli & Jaworski, 1990), contemporary management accounting practices assist in enabling organisations to manage the intensity of competitive forces.

These findings contribute to the literature by providing an empirical insight into the theoretical role of a specific internal mechanism, the extent of use of manage­ ment accounting practices, in managing the effects of competitive forces within an organisation.

Overall, this study makes a significant contribution to the literature on competitive forces and management accounting by highlighting the important role of manage­ ment accounting practices in coping with industry competitive pressures to enhance competitive advantage and organisational performance.
